reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness lifecycle integration that recalls and persists project and account memory through the TMCRA API across conversations and connected tools.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的对话生命周期连接到 TMCRA，在每轮对话前召回相关项目记忆并在完成后保存用户与助手记录。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to TMCRA to recall relevant project memory before each turn and save separate user and assistant records afterward.

capabilities: Reads user prompts and assistant results for memory recall and writeback
Sends recalled and recorded conversation data to the TMCRA Memory API
Stores TMCRA connection credentials in the local Harness credential store
Derives project scopes from workspace and Git metadata
Maintains a durable local outbox for failed memory writes
